# MMTR (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 7 measured or mapped, 7 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 20 not measured

## Measurements

MMTR.TotVAh | apparent-energy | phase total | unit VAh | mmtr.totvah
MMTR.TotWh | active-energy | phase total | unit Wh | mmtr.totwh
MMTR.TotVArh | reactive-energy | phase total | unit VArh | mmtr.totvarh
MMTR.SupWh | active-energy | phase total | direction supply | unit Wh | mmtr.supwh
MMTR.SupVArh | reactive-energy | phase total | direction supply | unit VArh | mmtr.supvarh
MMTR.DmdWh | active-energy | phase total | direction demand | unit Wh | mmtr.dmdwh
MMTR.DmdVArh | reactive-energy | phase total | direction demand | unit VArh | mmtr.dmdvarh
